    Proposition 11.3(2): scalar fibres are positive filtered deformations #

    binary-families.tex (prop:zero-product-family(2)): "Every scalar fibre is a positive filtered deformation of A₀." A scalar fibre of the family m + Σ_E T_E μ_E is the product x · y = xy + Σ_E λ_E μ_E(x, y), that is xy + coch_a(x, y) for a coefficient function a constant on the classes (EdgeOK). For Θ : kP ≅ Λ carrying each ray to a homogeneous element of degree deg ℓ(r): the product is associative (Prop 11.3(1), family_assoc) and unital (corrections vanish at identities, coch_e_left, coch_e_right); a correction u q_y v has degree at least deg ℓ(u) + deg ℓ(v) + 1 (deg_eps), so the product agrees with that of Λ up to terms of higher degree, and the length filtration makes the fibre a positive filtered deformation (Definition 6.2, Fib.posFiltration).
